description: This Java source file implements the HibernateLocationDAO class, which provides database access methods for Location-related entities in the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes CRUD operations, querying, and complex retrievals involving tags and attributes.

classes.name: HibernateLocationDAO
classes.description: Implementation of LocationDAO interface leveraging Hibernate ORM for database operations related to Location, LocationTag, LocationAttributeType, and LocationAttribute entities.

methods.name: setSessionFactory
methods.description: Assigns the Hibernate SessionFactory for database sessions.

methods.name: saveLocation
methods.description: Saves or updates a Location entity; handles child locations explicitly for Hibernate limitations.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its ID.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a Location by its name using Criteria API.

methods.name: getAllLocations
methods.description: Returns all locations, optionally including retired ones, ordered by retired status and name.

methods.name: deleteLocation
methods.description: Deletes a Location entity.

methods.name: saveLocationTag
methods.description: Saves or updates a LocationTag.

methods.name: getLocationTag
methods.description: Fetches a LocationTag by its ID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByName
methods.description: Fetches a LocationTag by its name.

methods.name: getAllLocationTags
methods.description: Returns all LocationTags, optionally including retired ones, ordered by name.

methods.name: getLocationTags
methods.description: Searches for LocationTags starting with a given case-insensitive string.

methods.name: deleteLocationTag
methods.description: Deletes a LocationTag.

methods.name: getLocationByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a Location by its UUID.

methods.name: getLocationTagByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a LocationTag by its UUID.

methods.name: getCountOfLocations
methods.description: Returns count of locations matching a name fragment and retired filter.

methods.name: getLocations
methods.description: Retrieves locations matching various filters including name fragment, parent, attributes, and retired status; supports pagination.

methods.name: getRootLocations
methods.description: Retrieves locations without parent, optionally including retired ones.

methods.name: getAllLocationAttributeTypes
methods.description: Returns all location attribute types.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttributeType by its ID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a LocationAttributeType by UUID.

methods.name: saveLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Saves or updates a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: deleteLocationAttributeType
methods.description: Deletes a LocationAttributeType.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a LocationAttribute by UUID.

methods.name: getLocationAttributeTypeByName
methods.description: Retrieves a LocationAttributeType by name.

methods.name: getLocationsHavingAllTags
methods.description: Fetches locations that have all specified tags, excluding retired ones; uses a subquery to count matching tags.
